text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...No waaaay!! Nothing's coming to mind at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
The deadline for the radio improv segment 
is right around the corner, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—Nah, at times like this, it's all about 
input. News, entertainment—let's take in 
as much as we can!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to great ideas, it's all 
about how much info you've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, searching relentlessly for an 
answer, Lucky Lilac ended up staying up 
late into the night...
